03Playing Game게임 진행

Each turn has two steps: play one card from your hand, then flip the top card of the deck. Any card that matches a floor card of the same month captures it.

In the real site this keeps its step-by-step animation. Special moves like Jjok and Ppeok are in 05 Special Rules.

    05Special Rules특수 규칙

    Extra moves that happen during a turn, plus two rules that change the final score.

    06Go or Stop?고? 스톱?

    The moment your score reaches the target, you choose. Stop ends the hand and you collect. Go keeps playing for a bigger score, but if someone else stops before you score again, you pay for the whole table.

    What each Go adds

    The 3rd Go is where the score starts doubling. Example: 5 points after 3 Gos = (5 + 2) × 2 = 14 from each opponent.
